title: Route_19
lead_summary:
Route 19 is a water-route and can only be used with Surf or its HM Replacement Item. It connects Fuchsia City to Route 20.
On the beach, there is a trainer which challenges the player to a surfing race. If the player wins, the trainer is rewarded with the HM Replacement Item, the Surfboard.

items.name: Surfboard
items.location_details: Given after winning the Surf race.

items.name: Antidote
items.location_details: Given by Swimmer Alice after defeating her.
